name: EPIC 246404700
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 8.4 solar radii and 1.12 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246404700 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.41988 (16th-84th percentiles 8.091501-8.761677), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,012 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.12 solar masses and 8.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,771 K at its surface.
